i.norm: Verifies that the standard Gaussian (mean = 0, sigma = 1, normalized peak = 1) can be evaluated through the {@link DerivativeStructure} overload. Evaluating at x = 12 yields exp(-12^2 / 2) = exp(-72) ~= 2.146e-32, i.e. the curve has effectively decayed to zero far out in the tail.
A constant DerivativeStructure holding the value 12 (no free variables, order 12).
